I told Hollis in your direct message to send the truck to **Bay 25**.

On Oct 14 Hollis told me privately that Bay 25 is now their dock for Marrow Agrisupply pickups on the Ashgrove project. I found nothing newer in your direct messages or in #central-team that changes this. I also suggested checking with the site before Thursday that the bay is free. Because this came from Hollis's own direct message, I kept the answer inside that conversation and didn't share it anywhere else.
